theory_binding.verification: git merge-base --is-ancestor for each merge commit; git diff --exit-code sharp_license_reviewed_head sharp_license_merge_commit -- path; repository formula/link checks

record_acceptance: deprecated is false and deprecation_reasons is null or empty
state equals successful and warnings is null or empty
elastic_tensor.ieee_format is a finite 6-by-6 GPa tensor
fitting_data has exactly 24 total strain-stress states and non-empty optimization and deformation task provenance
structure composition equals elemental_composition after gcd reduction
the standardized structure has the registered space group, exact AFLOW prototype and Wyckoff signature, and no partial occupancies
the same locked standardized structure supplies candidate geometry and reference values; formula-only or nearest-polymorph matching is forbidden
a0 is derived from the conventional cubic standardized cell and the lattice is cubic within relative length tolerance 1e-6 and absolute angle tolerance 1e-6 degree
C11/C12/C44 are derived only from elastic_tensor.ieee_format after cubic-equivalent entries agree exactly at source precision
a0, C11, C12, and C44 are finite and strictly positive
cubic Born checks C11-C12 > 0, C11+2*C12 > 0, and C44 > 0 all pass
raw-query, structure, reference, and source-pool hashes all reconcile

elastic_convention.model_measurement_requirement: fully relaxed equilibrium cell plus internal-coordinate relaxation at every symmetric finite strain, converted to the same IEEE convention

selection_algorithm: Parse the source-pool lock as UTF-8 JSON and reject duplicate candidate_id or source_structure_id values.
Validate every Materials Project record and reference against materials_project_reference_contract before eligibility.
Derive all four grouping keys with the hash-locked executable and vocabulary; supplied derived labels are forbidden.
Remove candidates whose source_structure_id occurs in any excluded prior panel; fuzzy identity substitution is forbidden.
For each candidate compute rank = lowercase_hex(SHA256(seed + U+0000 + class + U+0000 + source_structure_id)).
Within each class sort by rank then source_structure_id, both ascending bytewise UTF-8, and select exactly the class quota.
Concatenate ionics-rocksalt then perovskites, assign panel_index 0 through 124, and emit canonical JSON sorted by panel_index.
Run the hash-locked role assignment only after the 125-structure panel is fixed; no model outputs, reference values, or outcomes may enter selection or role assignment.
The output must contain exactly 63 ionics-rocksalt plus 62 perovskite structures and exactly 125 unique candidate_id and source_structure_id values.

calibration_rules.calibration_membership: role equals calibration and rule key exactly equals held-out target rule key

hull_license_and_escape_algorithm: For held-out target X, registered model m, property p, and one named rule, select only fixed calibration-role structures whose derived key exactly equals X's key; X and every held-out target are excluded from every calibration hull.
Require at least four calibration structures; otherwise emit INSUFFICIENT_GROUP_CALIBRATION for the exact rule/model/target/property.
Convert each calibration predicted/reference ratio and the later held-out target ratio to integer U=10000 by decimal round-half-even; set lo=min and hi=max on calibration ratios only.
Record hull_width_scaled=hi-lo and normalized_hull_width=(hi-lo)/U as an exact rational or canonical decimal, never a binary-floating recomputation.

Apply the registered optimal-bias estimator and THEORY-4 rounding-robust gate independently to each rule's calibration hull; emit SHARP_LICENSED or SHARP_LICENSE_ABSTAIN and never copy a hull or decision across rules.
The held-out target escapes exactly when target_ratio_scaled < lo or hi < target_ratio_scaled; equality is in-hull.
For an escape record escape_overshoot_scaled=lo-target_ratio_scaled below the hull or target_ratio_scaled-hi above it; in-hull overshoot is zero.

Report exact escape numerator and denominator over admitted held-out target cells. Do not compute a binomial or Wilson confidence interval because the split is fixed and the campaign reports the finite registered panel.

For positive overshoots report the complete sorted integer list and nearest-rank p50 and p90 using rank=max(1,ceil(q*n)); report max. If there are no positive overshoots, emit NO_ESCAPES_OBSERVED and null quantiles.

Apply correction and count primary correction wins only under the v4 class rule. Secondary rule licenses answer grouping admissibility and never create substituted corrected predictions or confirmatory wins.
Compute the predecessor exact-tuple grouping diagnostic on the same fixed calibration/test roles; never relabel it as a v2 replay or v4 confirmatory endpoint.

analysis_requirements.secondary_width_contrasts: chemistry/prototype/neighbourhood versus class, paired within the same fixed held-out target and model then median across exactly four models; one-sided exact sign test for narrower alternative; 18 class-by-elastic-property-by-alternative-rule tests with Holm FWER 0.1
